eventDetail.scope: IEEE ETCM 2026 aims to provide a comprehensive and highly prestigious venue for academics, engineers and researchers in particular from Ecuador Technical Chapters fields of expertise. The conference covers both theoretical and practical issues related to Communications, Computer and Software Engineering, Computational Intelligence, Systems and Control, Industrial Electronics, Engineering in Medicine and Biology, Power and Energy, Circuits, Systems and Electron Devices, Education in Engineering,Robotics and Automation, Social issues and professional practice and others.
